approved_tools.name: Explore Shapes Around Us
approved_tools.purpose: Explore a ball, dice, bottle, shoebox and birthday cap. Rotate and observe, match similar objects and notice which can roll, slide or stand.

approved_tools.name: Meet the 3D Shapes
approved_tools.purpose: Rotate each solid, observe it from different sides, recognise/name it and match it with familiar objects.

approved_tools.name: Explore Faces, Edges and Corners
approved_tools.purpose: Select a face, trace an edge, identify a corner and compare features across solids.

approved_tools.name: Identify Shapes in Constructions
approved_tools.purpose: Select parts, identify the solid shape, count shapes and use position words such as on top, under and between.

approved_tools.name: Build and Describe
approved_tools.purpose: Arrange shapes to create a model; describe where each shape is placed; recreate a model from a simple description.

approved_tools.name: Build with Clay, Sticks and Cubes
approved_tools.purpose: Join clay balls and sticks, explore what they represent, combine cubes and count visible/hidden cubes where relevant.
approved_tools.flow_row: Build with Clay, Sticks and Cubes

approved_tools.name: Compare and Discover
approved_tools.purpose: Compare solids, identify shared/different properties and explain observations using simple prompts.

approved_tools.name: Shape Challenges and Games
approved_tools.purpose: Apply learning through shape identification, dice patterns, opposite-face predictions and different-view challenges.
